definitions.explanation: Someone who entered an organization, school, or profession after you.

examples.english: I received a consultation from a junior.

notes:
Part of the ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧/{後輩|こうはい} (senior/junior) relationship system important in Japanese culture.

USAGE:
- Used as a noun to refer to juniors
- Often used with possessive: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後輩|こうはい} (my junior)
- Less commonly used as a direct address (unlike ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧/{後輩|こうはい} system establishes social hierarchy in schools and workplaces. {後輩|こうはい} are expected to show respect to their ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧.
